title: Urine Albumin-to-Creatinine Ratio
subtitle: What urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio measures, how to interpret it, limitations, and when it is clinically useful.
evidence_strength: Strong evidence supports the use of UACR for early detection and monitoring of chronic kidney disease; moderate evidence supports utility in risk stratification for cardiovascular disease. Limitations include biological variability and influences from transient physiological states.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
